subject.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto

question: After the production embedded path is wired and proven, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106297 be the canonical fix for critical tool-loop termination?
rationale: Both branches target the same open issue with substantially the same contract, and selecting the permanent implementation requires an agent-runtime owner to compare runtime coverage, transcript semantics, and proof quality.

options.title: Repair and select this PR
options.body: Require this branch to wire the callback into the production embedded Agent and provide embedded-runtime proof before selecting it as canonical.

options.title: Select the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106297 if it first provides complete production wiring and stronger real-runtime proof.

options.title: Replace both candidates
options.body: Pause both only if the runtime owner identifies a narrower existing termination seam that covers single and mixed batches without parallel session contracts.

recommendation.title: Repair and select this PR
recommendation.body: Require this branch to wire the callback into the production embedded Agent and provide embedded-runtime proof before selecting it as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-runtime merge history makes this person the best available owner for the permanent runtime boundary and canonical candidate choice.
